articles.title: Bitcoin whale that sat through the March 2020 crash moves $378 million
articles.description: A bitcoin whale that received coins days before the Covid crash and sat through it has moved millions on-chain.

articles.title: Tokenized SanDisk bets saw more liquidations than XRP as Asia’s chip rout wipes out $800 million
articles.description: About $800 million in leveraged positions were wiped out over 24 hours, 86% of them bullish. Chip-stock contracts on crypto exchanges took a chunk of the damage.

articles.title: Once-largest Ethereum NFT marketplace Blur is shutting down after volumes collapse 99%
articles.description: Blur will close its website on Nov. 12 after monthly trading fell from about $1.43 billion at its 2023 peak to under $7 million, ten days after sister project Blast announced its own shutdown.

articles.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $83,000 as it decouples from tumbling Korean stocks and Nasdaq futures
articles.description: Bitcoin climbed back above $83,000 after an early dip, decoupling from a sharp slide in Korean chip stocks and weakness in Nasdaq futures ahead of Thursday’s US CPI report.

articles.title: Palantir's Europe head warns the region is 'missing the boat' on AI just as it did with the internet
articles.description: The Palantir UK chief said the U.S. is racing ahead on enterprise AI while Europe hesitates, and explained why he thinks the company faces intense political attacks.

articles.title: Tom Lee sees $2 trillion wealth transfer fueling crypto demand as Bitmine buys more ether
articles.description: The Bitmine chairman said he expects younger investors to drive demand for digital assets as his ether treasury company inches closer to owning 5% of the total supply.

articles.title: Tokenized catastrophe bonds target the disaster-insurance gap
articles.description: A planned Bermuda issuance would put legal ownership onchain and seek capital for disaster risks that remain costly to insure.

articles.title: Standard Chartered offers RLUSD custody in Dubai and plans LMAX collateral link
articles.description: Ripple previously gave LMAX $150 million in financing to integrate RLUSD into its institutional infrastructure.

articles.title: Ledger claims CryptoBilis cases are limited as up to $93 million is traced, $10 million frozen
articles.description: Ledger said every confirmed case involves devices sold by the Southeast Asian reseller, but critics say the hardware-wallet maker must answer for an authorized sales channel.

articles.title: Bitcoin falls below $83,000 as dollar strength keeps markets on edge
articles.description: Bitcoin and gold hold steady as a firm dollar and rising bond yields weigh on sentiment, while IREN secures a multiyear cloud services deal with Anthropic.

articles.title: Global financial watchdog calls for cross-border information sharing, planning for stablecoin crisis
articles.description: Coins jointly issued by multiple companies can trap reserves in one jurisdiction while redemption demands hit another, complicating cross-border crisis response.

articles.title: South Korea just got its first traditional bank loans backed by bitcoin
articles.description: Loans use third-party custodians for bitcoin holdings and rely on court-ordered sales if borrowers default.

articles.title: SWI raises $894 million to repurpose former FTX bitcoin miner Genesis Digital to AI
articles.description: SWI Group said it would use the proceeds from an 800 million-euro ($894 million) fundraise to transform Genesis Digital Assets, acquired from the FTX bankruptcy, from a bitcoin miner to an AI-focused data center.

articles.title: Altcoins rally on thin trading as bitcoin holds below $83,500
articles.description: The CoinDesk 80 has risen around 3% in 24 hours, more than double the CoinDesk 5, while spot bitcoin ETFs lost $681 million last week.

articles.title: U.S. inflation, Ethereum upgrade talks: Crypto Week Ahead
articles.description: Your look at what's coming in the week starting Oct. 12.

articles.title: Why a bug that could have threatened XRP's 100 billion supply cap stayed hidden for years
articles.description: The XRP Ledger Foundation said normal parameters never triggered the bug that could have broken XRP's supply cap, which is why it was undetected for years.

articles.title: Ledger says unauthorized implant found in at least one device sold by CryptoBilis
articles.description: Ledger confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in a device linked to crypto losses at CryptoBilis, a Southeast Asian reseller. The company says confirmed cases are limited and its internal systems remain unaffected.

articles.title: Bitcoin pulls back from $84,000 as oil recovers, ETFs bleed over $600 million
articles.description: Bitcoin reversed early gains as oil bounced back to over $92. Analysts express concerns over large outflows from spot ETFs last week.

articles.title: Everyone wants SCOTUS to take up prediction markets: State of Crypto
articles.description: The U.S. Supreme Court hasn't yet indicated whether it will take up cases surrounding prediction markets, but there are now several amicus briefs, an interim final rule and a rule proposal.

articles.title: Clarity's failure could speed crypto innovation while shielding incumbents
articles.description: Executives see openings for tokenization, DeFi and dealmaking, while lawyers warn agency action leaves spot-market oversight and lasting certainty unresolved.

articles.title: President Trump declares 'energy ceasefire' between Russia and Ukraine
articles.description: "Ukraine supports the ceasefire, and it is important that Russia support it as well," said Ukrainian President Zelensky.

articles.title: IMF finds demand for tokenized stocks, says the market is still volatile, illiquid
articles.description: Investors are using blockchain-based shares for smaller and after-hours trades. The IMF says liquidity, legal rules and settlement systems have not caught up.

articles.title: One year after 10/10 flash crash, bitcoin and ether liquidity have rebuilt, but altcoins still face risks
articles.description: Bitcoin and ether order books are deeper than before the crash, while altcoin liquidity keeps eroding and spot trading remains well below its October 2025 peak.

articles.title: Tokenized commodities look beyond gold as lending and oil open new markets
articles.description: Paxos Labs, Theo and Energy Substantiation execs see growth coming from putting physical assets to work, with precious metals leading and energy presenting a tougher test.

articles.title: Bitcoin's $19 billion wake-up call: One-year after flash crash, has crypto learned anything?
articles.description: The Oct. 10, 2025 flash crash wiped out billions in leveraged crypto bets. Traders now have better tools to spot risks, but the forces behind the selloff remain.
